problems.explain: Two triangle ends, each ½ × 8 × 6 = 24, make 48. The three rectangles all run the length, 8, and are as wide as the three sides of the triangle: (8 + 6 + 10) × 8 = 24 × 8 = 192. Together 48 + 192 = 240. (The slanted face is 10 wide, the longest side, and is easy to leave out.) So 240 yd².
